name: form
title: Form
description: A fitness and yoga studio theme in chalk white, charcoal and one coral-red accent whose signature is the timetable: big tabular class times you can read at arm's length on a phone, day blocks that never scroll sideways, and a print layout that pins to the fridge.

tokens.--font-display: headings, the site title, day names, and the class times (geometric and heavy)
tokens.--font-body: body text, class names, and the menu
tokens.--weight-display: how heavy the class times, headings, and site title are
tokens.--weight-strong: weight of class names, menu links, buttons, and small labels
tokens.--text-xs: the Today badge and the smallest print labels
tokens.--text-s: small text: teacher and level under a class name, menu links, labels, footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size, and the day names on the timetable
tokens.--text-l: the intro line under a page title and the site title
tokens.--text-xl: section headings and instructor names in the list
tokens.--text-time: the timetable's class times — the largest type in every day block
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of headings and class times
tokens.--tracking-heads: letter spacing of headings and class times (slightly tight)
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of uppercase labels and day names (open)
tokens.--color-panel: background of the timetable's day blocks, quotes, and code blocks
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, and the class times
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: teacher names, levels, intro lines, footer, and times of classes already under way today
tokens.--color-accent: coral-red: links, the Try a class button, small labels, today's marker, and the next class time
tokens.--color-on-accent: text placed on the accent color (the Today badge, the button when hovered)
tokens.--color-accent-tint: soft coral wash behind today's day name and selected text
tokens.--color-border: thin lines: day block edges, lines between classes, table rows, the footer rule
tokens.--color-rule: the heavy rules under the masthead, under each day name, and above each instructor
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--page-width: maximum page width (masthead, timetable, instructor grid)
tokens.--card-min: narrowest an instructor card may get before the grid drops a column; the photo on a card is a third of this wide, and the photo on an instructor's own page is at most this wide on a phone
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between a name and the line under it
tokens.--space-2: small gap: padding of a class row and of labels
tokens.--space-3: base step: page gutter, gap between day blocks, padding inside them
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections of a page
tokens.--space-5: gap above the footer and between the two columns of an instructor's page
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of day blocks, buttons, badges, and photos
tokens.--border-hairline: width of thin lines (day block edges, lines between classes)
tokens.--border-strong: width of the heavy rules under the masthead and each day name, and of the button outline
tokens.--rule-accent: thickness of the accent marks: the underline of the current menu item, the bar beside the first-class note and quotes, and the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--tap-target: minimum touch height of buttons and menu links
tokens.--photo-ratio: instructor photo shape as width divided by height (0.8 is a 4:5 portrait)
